convert_gaussian_feat_pca: convert Gaussian extra features to RGB colors using PCA dimensionality reduction and blend with existing features
improve_saturation: improve the color saturation of Gaussian spherical harmonic features by a configurable factor
convert_gaussian_grayscale: convert Gaussian spherical harmonic features to grayscale by averaging color channels
blend_gaussian_with_color: blend Gaussian features with custom RGB colors using an alpha-weighted linear combination
cancel_feature_rest: zero out all higher-order spherical harmonic rest features in a Gaussian model
